task.description:
Produce a design artefact at `src/design/definition.md` for the process definition module covering PD-01 (Create definition) and PD-02 (Graph validation). PD-02 validation runs inside the PD-01 create path, so both must be designed together.

The design MUST include:
1. Module file layout: `src/definition/store.zig` (CRUD + queries), `src/definition/graph.zig` (graph validation logic).
2. Public API surface: function signatures with parameter types and return types.
3. Data types: `Definition`, `DefinitionGraph`, `GraphNode`, `GraphEdge`, `NodeType` (START, END, USER_TASK, SERVICE_TASK, EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY, PARALLEL_GATEWAY, SCRIPT_TASK), `DefinitionStatus` (DRAFT, ACTIVE, DEPRECATED, ARCHIVED).
4. Database mapping: how definition rows map to `migrations/004_definitions.sql`.
5. Graph validation algorithm outline for PD-02 checks (one START, at least one END, no dangling edges, no isolated nodes, no duplicate node IDs, no non-gateway cycles, count limits ≤500 nodes / ≤2000 edges).
6. Error types defined in a per-module error set.
7. Concurrency safety note for the unique(name, version) constraint (HTTP 409 path).
acceptance_criteria: src/design/definition.md exists and documents all types and function signatures
Graph validation algorithm is outlined with named checks
All PD-01 and PD-02 acceptance criteria are traceable to design elements

result.summary: Design artefact for the process definition module (PD-01, PD-02). Produced src/design/definition.md covering: module file layout (store.zig + graph.zig), all required data types (Definition, DefinitionGraph, GraphNode, GraphEdge, NodeType, DefinitionStatus), public function signatures for Store and graph.validateGraph(), database column mapping to migrations/004_definitions.sql, eight named PD-02 validation checks (CHK-01..CHK-08) with DFS cycle-detection algorithm outline, per-module error sets (DefinitionError, GraphError), concurrency safety analysis for the HTTP 409 path, state transition diagram, dependency constraints, and a full PD-01/PD-02 acceptance criteria traceability table.
